description: Writes the CSS for a custom theme applied with ui.cssClass: a .tp-ui-wrapper.<name> block of --tp- variables. Pass `overrides` to emit only those, or leave it empty for an editable scaffold of the variables built-in themes change. Unknown variables and variables no rule reads are reported.

name.description: Class name for ui.cssClass, e.g. 'ocean'. Letters, digits, - and _.

onlyCommon.description: For the scaffold, include only the variables built-in themes override.

overrides.description: Map of CSS variables to values, e.g. { 'tp-primary': '#0ea5e9' }.

name: generate_custom_theme
title: Generate a custom theme stylesheet
